description:
The two biggest AI writing tells are ones most people never catch.

Short staccato sentences stacked back to back is the first. Natural speech doesn't work that way. Real cadence runs long, long, short, then back again.

The second is contrast negation. "Cannot" instead of "can't." "Do not" instead of "don't." AI defaults to formal contractions every time, and it reads as robotic full stop.

The fix is simple. Paste your script into Claude and tell it to enforce a long, long, short rhythm and collapse every formal contraction. That alone closes most of the gap.
